A '''marine biologist''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] specialization. The [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] had a marine biologist assigned to the base during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Alongside an [[Astrophysicist/Legends|astrophysicist]], the scientists were studying the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] unusual [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] waves.<ref name="BGS" />
